advice_items.quote: take 10 of your income put in a stock index fund and all your other Investments are outside of that follow that strictly
advice_items.summary_en: Strictly allocate 10% of your income to a stock index fund separately from all other investments.
advice_items.summary_zh: 严格将10%收入定投股票指数基金

advice_items.quote: a lot of people misestimate the initial first second and third tranches so thinking through that and having experts around you to do that
advice_items.summary_en: Plan ahead for the distinct demands of each scaling stage rather than assuming the second or third stage looks like the first.
advice_items.summary_zh: 提前规划多阶段扩张并借助专家力量

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: assessing your Market... understanding that next level is saying is there a market number one and if there's a huge market then what's the right approach
advice_items.summary_en: To scale from seven to eight figures, verify there is a huge scalable market first and then determine the right approach.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先评估庞大增量市场再制定扩张路径

advice_items.quote: getting the right people to tell you how to get there... just not trying to figure out on your own
advice_items.summary_en: Don't try to figure out scaling all on your own; surround yourself with experts and the right people who can guide you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别事事亲力亲为，要请教专业人士

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在多个行业担任业务拓展与销售副总裁多年，后自立门户创立公司，专门帮企业诊断并提升销售业绩。
guests.role_or_title: Business Development & Sales Consultant / Former VP

advice_items.quote: pay yourself first and that goes to your retirement because Social Security is probably not going to be around
advice_items.summary_en: Pay yourself first by putting money into retirement savings early rather than relying on Social Security.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先付钱给自己，趁早为退休储蓄投资

advice_items.quote: look at what's going on where is their traction and then invest in there it's not a fly-by-night company
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid fly-by-night companies; invest only where you can see real, sustained traction.
advice_items.summary_zh: 避开昙花一现的公司，投有增长的项目

advice_items.quote: you live every day and you only die once... don't put off today what you could miss out on tomorrow
advice_items.summary_en: Adopt a 'you only die once' mindset—live every day like it's your last and don't put off today what you could miss tomorrow.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持每天最后一天心态，绝不拖延到明天

guests.zero_start_advice: 建议趁早“先付钱给自己”为退休储蓄，并秉持“只死一次（YODO）”心态，不要把今天能做的事拖延到明天。

advice_items.quote: here I finally feel accepted for wanting to work till 10 or 11 or until 3 A.M
advice_items.summary_en: Don't let lifestyle-shaming deter your work ethic; embrace working late and putting in relentless hours.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无惧外界对拼命工作的嘲讽，保持极致投入

advice_items.quote: when you're around people that are thinking bigger it creates this environment and container that pushes what's possible for you
advice_items.summary_en: Immerse yourself in high-wealth environments with bigger thinkers to constantly push what you see as possible.
advice_items.summary_zh: 置身格局更大、财富密度高的圈层环境

advice_items.quote: fail faster and don't make it mean shit... failing forward intelligently learning from their mistakes faster
advice_items.summary_en: Fail forward faster and strip emotional weight from small setbacks so you learn and compound quicker.
advice_items.summary_zh: 快速试错向前失败，别放大负面情绪

advice_items.quote: it all comes down to top tier talent... you cannot have talent without really good compensation packages
advice_items.summary_en: Scaling big ventures comes down to fundraising and recruiting top-tier talent backed by strong leadership and great compensation.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠强领导力和优厚薪酬招募顶尖人才

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: you can't have good compensation packages if you don't have a badass product that sells itself
advice_items.summary_en: Build an undeniable product that sells itself—great products power compensation, talent recruitment, and scale.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打磨能自销的硬核产品作为商业基石

guests.zero_start_advice: 建议快速试错向前失败（Fail faster），不要把小失败看得太重；同时主动融入不排斥拼搏、富人与大格局者云集的环境。

advice_items.quote: relationships is everything... whenever you want to develop a relationship with somebody... you come to the table with something to offer
advice_items.summary_en: Relationships are everything—connect with key players in every city and always bring something of value to the table.
advice_items.summary_zh: 人脉决定一切，带着价值去结交关键人物

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: learning how to leverage your credit you know that means that you can save your cash
advice_items.summary_en: Learn how to leverage credit wisely so you can preserve and accumulate your cash reserves.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会善用信用杠杆以保留手头现金流

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: understanding the whole 70 30 rule whatever you earn you know you want to be able to save 70 of it and pretty much operate off of 30
advice_items.summary_en: Follow the 70/30 rule by saving 70% of everything you earn and operating strictly off the remaining 30%.
advice_items.summary_zh: 遵循70/30法则，存下七成收入运转

guests.first_money_or_break: 作为软件工程师自主创业，承接宾州州立大学、洛克希德·马丁及德州政府等机构的应用开发项目，单年最高收入约200万美元。
guests.guest_name: Brickell Software Engineer & App Company Owner
guests.role_or_title: Software Engineer & App Development Company Owner

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: I'm doing this for all these other people let me just start my own brand
advice_items.summary_en: Stop just servicing demanding clients—use your skills to build and own your own brand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从替甲方打工转向创立自有品牌掌股权

advice_items.quote: they built a brand that is so powerful so strong they can release any product and people would buy
advice_items.summary_en: Build a brand so powerful that customers implicitly trust and buy any product you launch.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打造强势品牌壁垒，让客户信赖买单

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: you have to figure out the winning product... it goes product marketing sales so if your product's good you don't need marketing
advice_items.summary_en: When starting from nothing in e-commerce, focus on finding a winning product first—product trumps marketing and sales.
advice_items.summary_zh: 电商从零起步重在爆品，产品优先于营销

advice_items.quote: you don't need a Mac you just need this you need the Internet
advice_items.summary_en: Start lean without expensive status gear like a Mac; a basic computer and an internet connection are all you need.
advice_items.summary_zh: 轻资产起步，有普通电脑和网络即可创业

advice_items.quote: the more I've been here it's like damn I gotta hustle harder... I just want to level up
advice_items.summary_en: Let ambitious, wealthy environments push you to hustle harder and level up your output.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在进取氛围中激发斗志，更加拼搏升级

guests.first_money_or_break: 最初靠社交媒体营销代理（SMMA）赚到第一个100万美元；因厌倦服务挑剔客户，转而创立自己的保健品与电商品牌，个人单年最高收入达350万美元（公司年营收约1400万美元）。
guests.zero_start_advice: 电商从零起步最容易赚钱的不是投流或营销，而是先找出真正能打的“爆款产品”（产品>营销>销售），并用低成本设备轻资产启动。

advice_items.quote: put my whole family in my back I like pressure and like when I put people on my back like I perform my best
advice_items.summary_en: Embrace responsibility for your family and use that pressure as fuel to perform at your highest level.
advice_items.summary_zh: 将家庭责任化作高压动力以发挥最佳

advice_items.quote: quit and Chase happiness you can't put a price on on happiness... work on your passion... try everything
advice_items.summary_en: Don't stay trapped in an unfulfilling job—quit, chase happiness, and try everything to discover your passion.
advice_items.summary_zh: 离开不快乐的工作，多方尝试追逐热爱

guests.first_money_or_break: 在德国第四级别联赛（Viktoria队）担任职业足球运动员，以肩负全家期望作为高压前行的动力。
guests.zero_start_advice: 若在不喜欢的岗位上感到挣扎，应果断辞职追寻快乐，多方尝试找到自己的热情所在。

advice_items.quote: ask a lot of questions find mentors and model their behaviors whatever it is you want to do in life it's already been done
advice_items.summary_en: Ask plenty of questions, find mentors who have already succeeded at your goal, and model their behaviors.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多提问并寻找过来人导师，效仿其路径

advice_items.quote: it's been unlimited possibilities for me it's the most important thing you can do
advice_items.summary_en: Surrounding yourself with the right people is the most important thing you can do to unlock unlimited possibilities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 与对的人为伍能为你带来无限可能

advice_items.quote: from owning that building he met that client there you go you can make money anywhere you want if you're entrepreneurial
advice_items.summary_en: Owning commercial real estate creates unexpected entrepreneurial deal flow—like a landlord backing a tenant's beverage brand into a public company.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资商业地产不仅赚租金还能衍生人脉商机

advice_items.quote: don't count other people's money... keeping up with the Joneses and they're buying things and spending money on things they really can't afford
advice_items.summary_en: Stop counting other people's money or buying things you can't afford just to keep up with the Joneses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别盯着他人钱包攀比虚荣而透支消费

advice_items.quote: you start comparing yourself to other people there's always going to be someone richer... worry about yourself go at your own pace
advice_items.summary_en: Ignore fake wealth on social media, stop comparing yourself to others, and focus on moving at your own pace.
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉社媒攀比焦虑，专注自己按节奏前进

guests.guest_name: South Florida Commercial Real Estate Developer
guests.role_or_title: Commercial Real Estate Property Manager & Developer
guests.zero_start_advice: 多提问、找已经成功的人当导师并模仿其行为；同时别与社交媒体上的虚假人设攀比，专注自身按自己的节奏前进。
